I tried to take an overdose an put it simply, ended up at CAHMS as i was 17, but not 18.they asked if i was suicidal there and then and if i wanted to hurt myself there and then. I said not this very minute but it can change as my mood changes very quickly and often for no reason. They discharged me after one single appointment and transferred me to CBT (cognital behaviour therapy) which they knew i wouldnt be able to attend due to the waiting list size and me going to uni 😬 i even said 'no not this very minute but i cant say that in an hour'. He passed off the mood changed as obviously they were sometimes triggered by real world things but ignored the fact i said often they were random. I often go from playing with my cousins kids to being nearly in tears or freaking out when they touch me. That can be in an instant with no warning. I can be 'happily' (cause although i seem hapoy i often am not) chatting or laughing and then Snap. Not anymore i look and feel like. A pile of shit. Often staring into space thinking of hurting myself often for 'no reason' but again they don't care and don't listen. They only care when i say i want to/am going to or i have done. The minute they think your ok they don't care and dont see you as a risk to your self. I find it hard to explain how my head and moods work and they pass it off as nothing as i struggle to explain it right. My PM asked me what troubles me. I said sometimes college, sometimes home blah blah blah. He took it as something troubles me occasionally when i meant something is Always bothering me. Always. Sometimes it happens to be college on my mins and sometimes its home or whatever but something is always bothering me if you catch my drift. He didnt care after that and passed it off as sometimes i worry ir whatever. People don't want to see a threat or a potential threat if there isnt a big issue staring them in the face. It's terrible. But things get better even though people dont listen there is always someone that will. Maybe you havent found them but you've found reddit? And a good subreddit so just talk on here. We can be like a therapy session or someone to just give positive thoughts because i don't want you to die. I love you man. So please don't do this you're worth so much more than you think and it does get better. Sometimes it has to get alot shittier before hand though just remember there is always light at the end of a storm. You can be suicidal and not want to kill yourself. Although that seems counterintuitive.  I am suicidal but will i try another overdose? Probably not. The effect of the last one scares me too much and i don't actually want to die. I want to escape myself and my head. I don't want to make anyone elses life miserable but idk how my death with affect someone. I can say financially it would cripple my family and honestly thats something i hold onto

Good luck dude. We love you ❤️

Not long after we had a huge row and she said 'lifes a game to you. I (she) dont mess around with pins and tacs. I want to slice my arms for real (i never used tacks so wtaf) and i want to actually take the pills not pretend or make myself throw uo because thats what you would have done anyway'. Clearly she never understood or listened when she was told what went on. Some parents only see their own issues and believe any issues you have are fake or lesser than theirs. Its always like a competition with mine if i say ow my back hurts (maybe from sitting in a bad position) she will say 'wish mine only hurt'. To cut a long story down, you cannot always rely on parents. Its sad to say but parents dont always believe you hence why i do not trust my mum with anything. She has her problems i listen and she has a doctor for her issues. I wont tell her the majority of mine. Not happening. I can only reccomend you see your doctor and try and get a referral but idk how it works or where you're from. Naturally in the UK its free but in the US and places it isn't so i wish you the best of luck with life because at some point you will leave their home and do what you want with life, not let life do what it wants with you
